description: This file defines a specialized append-only list container optimized for profiling use cases, including class templates, methods for appending, copying, and iterating over elements, and internal management of memory blocks.

classes.name: AppendOnlyList
classes.description: A custom container class designed for append-only operations with optimized memory management for profiling scenarios.

classes.name: AppendOnlyList::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing the AppendOnlyList container.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the list.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs a new element at the end of the list with provided arguments.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from an ArrayRef into the list, optimizing for trivial types.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the container, clearing all stored data.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the list.
